title: Generating Airway Organoids from Nasal Epithelia for CFTR Assay
author: Rodenburg, van der Windt, et al.
materials: The following variations of AO medium are used.

steps.title: Precoat wells for basal expansion
steps.instruction: Coat each well of a 12‑ or 6‑well plate with collagen IV (50 µg/mL in PBS⁰) and incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 1–24 h. Add 500 µL per well for a 12‑well plate or 1 mL per well for a 6‑well plate. After coating, replace the solution with PBS⁰ (1 mL for 12‑well, 2 mL for 6‑well), wrap in foil and store at 4 °C for up to 14 days.

steps.title: Precoat Transwell inserts for ALI
steps.instruction: Coat the apical side of each Transwell insert with PureCol (30 µg/mL in PBS⁰) and incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 1–24 h. Add 200 µL for a 6.5 mm (24‑well) insert or 400 µL for a 12 mm (12‑well) insert. After coating, replace with PBS⁰ (300 µL for 6.5 mm, 600 µL for 12 mm), fill the basolateral compartment with PBS⁰, wrap in foil and store at 4 °C for up to 14 days.

steps.title: Prepare reagent stock solutions
steps.instruction:
Dissolve and filter‑sterilize the following reagents as indicated, store at the listed temperature and concentration:
- 3,3′,5‑Triiodo‑L‑thyronine sodium salt: 100 mg in 100 mL NaOH (0.2 M), filter 0.22 µm, 1 mg/mL, –80 °C.
- (±)-Epinephrine HCl: 25 mg in 5 mL PBS⁰, filter 0.22 µm, 5 mg/mL, –20 °C.
- Hydrocortisone: 5 mg in 1 mL 100 % EtOH then 49 mL Ad‑DF, filter 0.22 µm, 100 µg/mL, –80 °C.
- N‑Acetyl‑L‑cysteine: 3.26 g in 40 mL PBS⁰ MQ, filter 0.22 µm, 500 mM, –20 °C (3 mo).
- Nicotinamide: 5 g in 41 mL PBS⁰ MQ, filter 0.22 µm, 1 M, –20 °C (3 mo).
- A83‑01: 10 mg in 4.74 mL DMSO, 5 mM, –80 °C or –20 °C (3 mo).
- DAPT: 10 mg in 1.16 mL DMSO, 20 mM, –20 °C (1 yr).
- DMH‑1: 10 mg in 5.2571 mL DMSO, 5 mM, –20 °C (2 yr).
- SB 202190: 5 mg in 500 µL DMSO, 30 mM, –20 °C (2 yr).
- TTNPB: 1 mg in 2.9 mL DMSO, 1 mM, –20 °C (1 yr).
- Y‑27632: 50 mg in 1.56 mL DMSO, 100 mM, –20 °C (2 yr).
- Recombinant human EGF: 100 µg in 2 mL PBS⁰‑0.1 % BSA, 50 µg/mL, –20 °C.
- Recombinant human FGF‑10: 1 mg in 1 mL PBS⁰‑0.1 % BSA, 1 mg/mL, –20 °C.
- Recombinant human FGF‑7: 100 µg in 1 mL PBS⁰‑0.1 % BSA, 100 µg/mL, –20 °C.
- Recombinant human HGF: 100 µg in 0.4 mL PBS⁰‑0.1 % BSA, 250 µg/mL, –20 °C.
- Recombinant human Neuregulin‑1β: 100 µg in 1333 µL PBS‑0.1 % BSA, 10 µM, –20 °C.
- Recombinant human IL‑1β: 10 µg in 1000 µL PBS‑0.1 % BSA, 10 µg/mL, 20 °C.
- RSPO3‑Fc conditioned medium: ready‑to‑use, –80 °C/–20 °C (3 mo).
- Collagen I: 10 mg in 10 mL 0.5 M acetic acid, 20×, –20 °C.
- Collagenase II: 1 g in 50 mL PBS⁰ MQ, 20 mg/mL, –20 °C.
- PureCol Type I solution: ready‑to‑use, 3 mg/mL, 4 °C (6 mo).
- Amphotericin B: ready‑to‑use, 250 mg/mL, –20 °C.
- Gentamicin: ready‑to‑use, 50 mg/mL, 4 °C.
- Pen‑Strep: ready‑to‑use, –20 °C.
- Primocin: ready‑to‑use, 50 mg/mL, –20 °C.
- Vancomycin: ready‑to‑use, 100 mg/mL, –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare collection medium
steps.instruction: Mix Advanced DMEM/F‑12 (Ad‑DF) 489 mL, GlutaMAX 5 mL (1 % v/v, 100×), Pen‑Strep 5 mL (1 % v/v, 100×), Primocin 1 mL (100 µg/mL, 50 mg/mL stock) to a final volume of 500 mL. Store at 4 °C for up to 1 yr.

steps.title: Prepare basic basal cell medium
steps.instruction:
Combine the following to 500 mL total:
- Advanced DMEM/F‑12 220 mL (44 % v/v)
- BEpiCM‑b 248 mL (49.6 % v/v)
- B‑27 supplement 10 mL (2 % v/v)
- GlutaMAX 5 mL (1 % v/v, 100×)
- HEPES 5 mL (10 mM, 1 M stock)
- T3 34 µL (100 nM, 1 mg/mL stock)
- (±)-Epinephrine 50 µL (0.5 µg/mL, 5 mg/mL stock)
- Hydrocortisone 2.5 mL (0.5 µg/mL, 100 µg/mL stock)
- N‑Acetyl‑L‑cysteine 1.25 mL (1.25 mM, 500 mM stock)
- Nicotinamide 2.5 mL (5 mM, 1 M stock)
- A83‑01 100 µL (1 µM, 5 mM stock)
- DMH‑1 100 µL (1 µM, 5 mM stock)
- SB 202190 8 µL (500 µM, 30 mM stock)
- Y‑27632 5 µL (5 µM, 100 mM stock)
- Pen‑Strep 5 mL (1 % v/v, 100×)
- Primocin 1 mL (100 µg/mL, 50 mg/mL stock).
Store at –20 °C (≤6 mo).

steps.title: Prepare BC isolation medium
steps.instruction:
Mix 10 mL basic BC medium (100 % v/v) with the following supplements to a final 10 mL:
- EGF 1 µL (5 ng/mL, 50 µg/mL stock)
- FGF‑7 2.5 µL (25 ng/mL, 100 µg/mL stock)
- FGF‑10 1 µL (100 ng/mL, 1 mg/mL stock)
- HGF 1 µL (25 ng/mL, 250 µg/mL stock)
- RSPO3‑Fc conditioned medium 200 µL (2 % v/v)
- Amphotericin B 10 µL (250 µg/mL)
- Gentamicin 10 µL (50 µg/mL)
- Vancomycin 5 µL (50 µg/mL).
Total volume 10 mL. Store at 4 °C for 2 weeks.

steps.title: Prepare BC expansion medium
steps.instruction:
Combine 490 mL basic BC medium (98 % v/v) with:
- DAPT 125 µL (5 µg/mL, 20 mM stock)
- EGF 50 µL (5 ng/mL)
- FGF‑7 125 µL (25 ng/mL)
- FGF‑10 50 µL (100 ng/mL)
- HGF 50 µL (25 ng/mL)
- RSPO3‑Fc conditioned medium 10 mL (2 % v/v).
Total 500 mL. Store at 4 °C for 2 weeks.

steps.title: Prepare ALI differentiation medium
steps.instruction:
To 500 mL total add:
- Advanced DMEM/F‑12 492 mL (98.4 % v/v)
- T3 34 µL (100 nM, 1 mg/mL stock)
- Hydrocortisone 2.5 mL (0.5 µg/mL, 100 µg/mL stock)
- (±)-Epinephrine 50 µL (0.5 µg/mL, 5 mg/mL stock)
- A83‑01 5 µL (50 nM, 5 mM stock)
- TTNPB 50 µL (100 nM, 1 mM stock)
- EGF 5 µL (0.5 ng/mL, 50 µg/mL stock)
- Pen‑Strep 5 mL (1 % v/v, 100×).
Store at 4 °C for 2 weeks.

steps.title: Prepare airway organoid medium
steps.instruction:
To 500 mL total add:
- Advanced DMEM/F‑12 474 mL (94.8 % v/v)
- B‑27 supplement 10 mL (2 % v/v)
- GlutaMAX 5 mL (1 % v/v, 100×)
- HEPES 5 mL (10 mM, 1 M stock)
- N‑Acetyl‑L‑cysteine 1.25 mL (1.25 mM, 500 mM stock)
- Nicotinamide 2.5 mL (5 mM, 1 M stock)
- A83‑01 50 µL (500 nM, 5 mM stock)
- Pen‑Strep 2.5 mL (0.5 % v/v, 100×).
Store at –20 °C (≤6 mo) or 4 °C (≤2 wk).

steps.title: Prepare tubes and brushes
steps.instruction: Label a 15 mL tube and add 7 mL collection medium; label a second 15 mL tube and add 5 mL PBS⁰. If needed for young children, create a smaller nasal brush by attaching a p200 non‑filter tip to an interdental brush with parafilm.

steps.title: Coat well and pre‑warm isolation media
steps.instruction: Coat one well of a 12‑well plate as described in step 1. Pre‑warm 500 µL BC isolation medium in a 37 °C water bath. Prepare freezing medium according to the “overview of media” (CryoStor CS10 with 5 µM Y‑27632).

steps.title: Cut pipette tip for brush loading
steps.instruction: Trim ~0.5 cm off the tip of a non‑filter p1000 pipette tip with ethanol‑cleaned scissors (or autoclave after cutting) to allow the nasal brush to pass through.

steps.title: Scrape cells from nasal brushes
steps.instruction: Place each brush in an empty 15 mL tube, add collection medium, and scrape the brush up‑and‑down through the cut pipette tip ~10 times. Discard the brush after scraping. Repeat for the second brush using the same cut tip.

steps.title: Centrifuge and enzymatically dissociate cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 400 g for 5 min at 4 °C. Aspirate supernatant and resuspend pellet in 4 mL TrypLE Express + 20 µL Sputolysin (0.5 % v/v). Incubate 5 min at 37 °C, pipette up/down ~5× to dissolve mucus, then incubate another 5 min at 37 °C. Add 8 mL Ad‑DF to inactivate TrypLE. Strain through a 100 µm cell strainer and wash strainer with 2 mL Ad‑DF.

steps.title: Split cell suspension for freezing and expansion
steps.instruction: Transfer half of the cell suspension to a new 15 mL tube (for freezing) and half to another tube (for expansion).

steps.title: Cryopreserve half of the cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge both tubes at 400 g for 5 min at 4 °C. For the freezing tube, aspirate supernatant and resuspend pellet in 500 µL CryoStor CS10 containing 5 µM Y‑27632. Aliquot into sterile cryovials, label with donor and passage number, place in a controlled‑rate freezing container at –80 °C for ~24 h, then transfer to liquid nitrogen storage.

steps.title: Seed cells for basal progenitor expansion
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the expansion tube at 400 g for 5 min at 4 °C. Aspirate supernatant and resuspend pellet in 1 mL BC isolation medium. Remove coating solution or PBS⁰ from the precoated well, add the cell suspension, and label plate with passage (p0) and donor. Refresh medium three times per week (max 2 consecutive non‑refresh days) with 1 mL BC isolation medium. After 7 days, switch to BC expansion medium. Culture until ~90 % confluence (typically 7–14 days).

steps.title: Passage confluent basal progenitor cells
steps.instruction:
When cultures reach ~90 % confluence, aspirate medium and wash cells with PBS⁰ (500 µL per well for 12‑well, 1 mL for 6‑well). Add TrypLE Express (same volumes as PBS⁰), incubate 10–15 min at 37 °C (extend 5 min if needed). Pipette to detach cells, transfer suspension to a 15 mL tube, then add Ad‑DF to inactivate TrypLE (1 mL per well for 12‑well, 2 mL for 6‑well). Count cells (average yield: 1–3 × 10⁶ per 12‑well, 4–7 × 10⁶ per 6‑well). Centrifuge 400 g 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, and reseed:
- 0.2 × 10⁶ cells in 1 mL BC expansion medium per 12‑well well
- 0.5 × 10⁶ cells in 2 mL BC expansion medium per 6‑well well.
Refresh three times per week with the same volumes.

steps.title: Freeze expanded basal cells
steps.instruction: After expansion, repeat the detachment steps (41‑46). Determine cell concentration, centrifuge 400 g 5 min at 4 °C, aspirate supernatant, and resuspend in CryoStor CS10 + Y‑27632 to achieve 1–2 × 10⁶ cells/mL. Aliquot 0.5 mL per cryovial (final 0.5–1 × 10⁶ cells/vial), label, freeze at –80 °C in a controlled‑rate container, then transfer to liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Thaw frozen basal cells
steps.instruction: Coat new wells as in step 1 and pre‑warm BC expansion medium. Retrieve a cryovial, keep on dry ice (max 14 days at –80 °C if not used). Thaw rapidly in a 37 °C water bath until almost liquid, transfer to a 15 mL tube containing 5 mL Ad‑DF, wash cryovial with 1 mL Ad‑DF and add to tube. Centrifuge 400 g 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, and resuspend pellet in BC expansion medium. Seed 1 mL per 12‑well well or 2 mL per 6‑well well. Refresh three times per week with BC expansion medium.

steps.title: Coat Transwell inserts for ALI differentiation
steps.instruction: Coat Transwell inserts as described in step 2 (PureCol coating).

steps.title: Pre‑warm ALI differentiation medium
steps.instruction: Warm ALI‑diff medium to 37 °C before use.

steps.title: Seed cells onto Transwell inserts for ALI
steps.instruction: After basal cells reach confluence, detach as in step 11, count, and seed the appropriate number onto the apical side of each precoated Transwell insert in a small volume of BC expansion medium. Allow cells to attach, then add ALI‑diff medium to the basolateral compartment. Change basolateral medium every 2–3 days.

steps.title: Prepare plates and Matrigel for organoid culture
steps.instruction: Pre‑warm 24‑well suspension plates (or 96‑well black flat‑bottom plates) in a tissue incubator for ≥24 h. Thaw Matrigel (or BME) on ice or at 4 °C. Pre‑warm AO culture medium (step 9).

steps.title: Embed cells in Matrigel to generate organoids
steps.instruction: Mix dissociated basal cells with cold Matrigel at the recommended density, dispense droplets into pre‑warmed suspension plates, allow Matrigel to solidify at 37 °C, then add AO medium. Culture organoids, changing medium every 2–3 days.

steps.title: Switch to AO FIS assay medium (5‑10 days prior)
steps.instruction: Replace organoid medium with 100 µL pre‑warmed AO FIS assay medium per well. Maintain for 5–10 days; organoids will lose lumen formation 2–5 days after this change.

steps.title: Add CFTR correctors (48 h prior)
steps.instruction: Refresh organoid medium with 100 µL AO FIS assay medium containing 5 µM each of VX‑809, VX‑445, and VX‑661 (or vehicle control).

steps.title: Prepare microscope and staining solutions
steps.instruction: Turn on the environmental control of the confocal microscope ≥1 h before the assay (37 °C, 5 % CO₂). Dissolve calcein‑green 50 µg in 6 µL DMSO, then dilute 1:750 (v/v) in Ad‑DF to obtain 10 µL per well. Prepare 2× stock solutions of forskolin (10 µM) and CFTR potentiator VX‑770 (10 µM) in Ad‑DF; dispense 125 µL of each stock into a new U‑bottom 96‑well suspension plate (final concentrations after 1:1 dilution will be 5 µM).

steps.title: Perform FIS assay
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL organoid‑containing medium (from step 15) to each well of a U‑bottom 96‑well plate. Add 125 µL of the appropriate 2× compound solution (forskolin, VX‑770, or vehicle) to achieve final 5 µM concentrations. Add calcein‑green solution (10 µL per well). Acquire time‑lapse confocal images at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for the desired duration.

steps.title: Quantify organoid swelling
steps.instruction: For each image, determine total organoid area using image‑analysis software (e.g., Zen, ImageJ, CellProfiler). Exclude particles <6 000 µm². Normalize each time point to baseline (t = 0 min set to 100 %). Average normalized values across technical replicates (≥4 wells). Calculate area‑under‑the‑curve (AUC) for each well as a single swelling metric. Perform statistical analysis (t‑test or ANOVA) on mean AUC values.
